paragraphs: [He reported:] “Rav Yehuda bar Zevida said” — Berakhot 12b.[^1]

notes.text: The bracketed reporting subject is supplied from the heading context; the short body explicitly says Rav Yehuda bar Zevida said and gives Berakhot 12b. It supplies no further saying or independently verified reporting chain. Abbahu’s heading title is abbreviated and retained as R'; full Rav belongs to Yehuda, not Zevida. The locator remains conventionally read, without independently checked edition mapping.
